SA30 (DISCONTINUED)

Streaming Integrated Amplifier

OVERVIEW
TECHNICAL SPEC
DOWNLOADS

The SA30 is a streaming integrated amplifier and DAC (Digital-to-Analog Converter) designed for serious music lovers. With an impressive 120W per channel of Class G amplification, the SA30 delivers effortless power for impeccable sound, control and efficiency. Featuring Dirac Live, state-of-the-art room correction technology, and HDMI ARC, the SA30 conveniently delivers unparalleled sound quality, optimized in your room. 

With support for streaming services including Spotify Connect (including Lossless with the latest SW update) and Tidal Connect Hi-Res, Apple AirPlay and Google Chromecast built-in, your favourite music is conveniently accessible with exceptional sound quality. The SA30 features a range topping ESS Sabre DAC, MQA decoding, and it is Roon Ready for those looking for limitless listening.
